evidence.title: Ithaca council passes moratorium on new Cornell events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca permit records and moratorium text
occurrences.quote_span: Effective immediately, the city will not issue new permits to the affected parties for assemblies, parades, special events and noise.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council amended moratorium resolution
occurrences.quote_span: The council also amended the moratorium Wednesday night to include a resolution "that the city calls upon Cornell to hand over investigation of violent sex crimes" to the Ithaca Police Department.
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca Common Council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca moratorium text and council renewal authority
occurrences.quote_span: is designed so that the council can choose to renew it on a monthly basis.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca moratorium text and mayoral statement
occurrences.quote_span: The moratorium will apply to Cornell University, its residential and nonresidential sorority and fraternity organizations, general student organizations, and university student affiliations, according to Ithaca's mayor, Robert Cantelmo.
occurrences.speaker: Robert Cantelmo
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca moratorium text
occurrences.quote_span: The moratorium, which is set to expire on Nov. 5,
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council amended moratorium resolution
occurrences.quote_span: The council also amended the moratorium Wednesday night to include a resolution "that the city calls upon Cornell to hand over investigation of violent sex crimes" to the Ithaca Police Department.
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca Common Council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert Cantelmo statement
occurrences.quote_span: Cantelmo said the city is demanding the school do more to "punish, monitor transparently and prevent sexual violence on campus."
occurrences.speaker: Robert Cantelmo
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert Cantelmo statement and moratorium enforcement guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Cantelmo said the moratorium is not intended to be applied in a way that would infringe on any student's right to exercise freedom of religion, speech or peaceful assembly.
occurrences.speaker: Robert Cantelmo
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council vote and adopted moratorium resolution
occurrences.quote_span: The Ithaca Common Council voted Wednesday night to pass a temporary moratorium on special events permits at Cornell University and called on the school to hand over investigations into "violent sex crimes" to the Ithaca Police Department.
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca Common Council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council roll-call vote and moratorium text
occurrences.quote_span: Effective immediately, the city will not issue new permits to the affected parties for assemblies, parades, special events and noise. The moratorium, which is set to expire on Nov. 5, passed by a 9-1 vote and is designed so that the council can choose to renew it on a monthly basis.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert Cantelmo statement and council moratorium record
occurrences.quote_span: Cantelmo said the council adopted the moratorium "based on substantial concerns for the safety, health, and welfare of the residents of, and visitors to, the city of Ithaca."
occurrences.speaker: Robert Cantelmo
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

evidence.title: Ithaca city council calls on Cornell to report sexual assault investigations to local police

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council October 7, 2026 roll-call vote
occurrences.quote_span: The resolution passed by a vote of 9-1.
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca city council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council meeting agenda for October 7, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The moratorium on events would expire on Nov. 5, unless the council were to take further action, according to a meeting agenda.
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca city council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University statement or NBC News correspondence about the October 7, 2026 vote
occurrences.quote_span: Cornell declined to comment, citing pending litigation.
occurrences.speaker: Cornell University
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council resolution text and enforcement provisions
occurrences.quote_span: The council did not say how the measure would be enforced or what would happen if the university did not comply.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits

occurrences.checkable_against: Ithaca Common Council October 7, 2026 vote and meeting agenda
occurrences.quote_span: The city council also voted on Wednesday to temporarily suspend affiliated student organizations at the university, such as fraternities, from new assemblies, parades and special events “due to public safety concerns.”
occurrences.speaker: Ithaca city council
occurrences.subject: Ithaca Common Council moratorium on Cornell University special events permits
